scope: Offline keyless SHEPHERD-RELAY allowlist. Records publisher-stated license, terms URL, and rate limit only. Does not fetch, scrape, sign, or encrypt.

sources.name: arXiv RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds
sources.license_scope: Descriptive metadata only. E-print files stay under the submitter's license.

rate_limit.published: When using the legacy APIs (including OAI-PMH, RSS, and the arXiv API), make no more than one request every three seconds, and limit requests to a single connection at a time.
rate_limit.scope_note: The limit applies to all machines under your control as a whole.

sources.name: Wikimedia content dumps
sources.license_scope: Original textual content, as stated on the dumps legal page. Some text is CC-only. Images and fair-use media are not covered by that default.
sources.excluded: Wikimedia Enterprise HTML dumps need an account and are not on this list.

rate_limit.published: Downloads are also rate limited and capped at 3 connections per-IP. Clients that do not respect the user-agent policy or who try to evade these limits may be blocked.

sources.name: arXiv OAI-PMH
sources.license_scope: Descriptive metadata only. E-print files stay under the submitter's license.

rate_limit.published: When using the legacy APIs (including OAI-PMH, RSS, and the arXiv API), make no more than one request every three seconds, and limit requests to a single connection at a time.
rate_limit.scope_note: The limit applies to all machines under your control as a whole.

sources.name: MedlinePlus XML files
sources.license_scope: Some MedlinePlus content is in the public domain. Other content is copyrighted and licensed specifically for use on MedlinePlus. Attribute use to MedlinePlus.gov.
sources.excluded: MedlinePlus RSS feeds are personal-use only and are not on this list.

rate_limit.published: MedlinePlus produces XML data sets that you are welcome to download and use. The XML files page does not publish a numeric request cap.

sources.name: PMC Open Access via OAI-PMH set pmc-open
sources.license_scope: License terms vary. Full text is limited to items whose license or usage rights allow reuse. set=pmc-open is the collection for which full text may be retrieved.

rate_limit.published: Requests are limited to 3 requests per second (rps); rates higher than that will receive an error message. Please make sure that your system does not make concurrent requests, even at off-peak times.

sources.name: National Weather Service API
sources.license_scope: NWS web information is in the public domain unless specifically noted otherwise. Third-party material on NWS pages is not public domain.
sources.excluded: NOAA token APIs, including Climate Data Online, require a token and are not on this list.

rate_limit.published: The rate limit is not public information, but allows a generous amount for typical use. If a Web Service isn't available users should limit the number of retries to 1 minute intervals.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap planet replication diffs
sources.license_scope: OpenStreetMap data, including the live replication diffs. Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors and keep share-alike on a derivative database.
sources.excluded: The editing API is not a bulk-read source. Overpass has its own policy and is not on this list.

rate_limit.published: Large or frequent data users must use the download service planet.osm, which offers the entire planet of vector data, as well as diffs for syncing on a minutely basis. That policy page does not publish a numeric requests-per-second cap for the replication diffs.

sources.name: GitHub public release assets
sources.license_scope: Each public repository's own published license. GitHub does not grant one license for every release asset.

rate_limit.published: The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour.
rate_limit.scope_note: Unauthenticated requests for public data, counted per originating IP address.
